facts.statement: The project .env at the repository root is the single source of truth for installed tool paths (A100_PREFIX, A100_TOOLCHAIN, A100_SYSROOT, A100_CROSS_PREFIX, A100_QEMU, A100_QEMU_CPU, A100_REFERENCE_PYTHON, PYTHONPATH, A100_PUBLIC_REFERENCE_CACHE, A100_NO_PYTHON_IMAGE, COMPILER_WORKFLOW_ATTACK_BROKER); a100_support/env.sh derives the same prefix and run-riscv.sh / run-reference.sh source it. .env declares no measurement/profiling tool and no benchmark entrypoint; none is required under correctness_only.
facts.source: read ./.env and a100_support/env.sh on 2026-11-04; every declared path resolved by the probes recorded in docs/compiler-agent/ENVIRONMENT.md

tasks.goal: Environment analysis for the A100 correctness-only compiler run: discover and verify, with executed probe evidence, every local capability the chip input's build/execution path requires (RISC-V cross toolchain: cc/as/ld, QEMU riscv64 execution endpoint with the declared CPU model, the native runtime transport in a100_support/, the compiled x86 Triton CPU reference environment, and any host driver Python needs), classify each declared tool as present+usable / present+unusable / absent with the exact command and output, run at least one end-to-end smoke that builds a trivial RISC-V program with the declared toolchain and executes it under the declared QEMU endpoint, record Facts with RUNTIME_PROBE/EMPIRICAL confidence and Assumptions for anything not probed, and record that the project .env is the single source of truth for these paths. Correctness_only scope: no timing/profiling stack, benchmark rate or measured performance is required; verify build/run tools and required resource/instruction observation capabilities instead.
acceptance: Every capability the chip input's execution path needs (cross-compile, assemble/link, QEMU execution, native runtime transport, reference comparison environment, host Python driver) is classified present+usable, present+unusable, or absent, each backed by the exact probe command and its output recorded as evidence.

At least one end-to-end smoke (build a trivial program with the declared cross toolchain and run it under the declared QEMU endpoint) has executed successfully and is recorded as evidence with its command and output.

Tool paths and versions are recorded as Facts with RUNTIME_PROBE or EMPIRICAL confidence and provenance naming the probe command; anything not probed is recorded as an Assumption with a validation method, and no unavailable claim exists without an attempted command and its error.
The declared QEMU endpoint's availability (qemu-riscv64 with the CPU model declared in .env) is probed with the exact command and recorded as a Fact or Assumption.
The single source of truth for tool paths (the project .env) is identified in the recorded facts, and the environment summary is written to docs/compiler-agent/ENVIRONMENT.md.
No timing, speedup or performance measurement is recorded or required (correctness_only scope).
tests: PYTHONPATH from .env loaded, python3 -m compiler_agent --root . --json gates reports G0 PASS after the task's facts are recorded
python3 -m compiler_agent --root . --json status lists recorded environment facts with confidence RUNTIME_PROBE or EMPIRICAL and no active UNKNOWN-confidence fact that blocks the build/run path
